title: Bulgebi language
description: Finisterre languages of Papua New Guinea
extract: Bulgebi is a nearly extinct Finisterre languages of Papua New Guinea. It is spoken in the Madang province near the Astrolabe Bay and the lower Nankina river, slightly inland on the eastern end of the southern coast.
